name: Rubio by San Polo
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (sanpolomontalcino.com) Modern Super Tuscan from San Polo in Montalcino - same terroir as Brunello! Rated 91 pts by James Suckling. Also available by the glass.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Super Tuscan | Dark fruit, spice & oak | Well-structured tannins | Modern Tuscan winemaking | Age-worthy complexity.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Red meats, grilled steaks, aged cheese, hearty pasta, bistecca.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: From a renowned Brunello producer at accessible price. Great introduction to Super Tuscan style!

name: "O'Lillo" by Baracchi
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (baracchiwinery.com) Approachable Super Tuscan from Baracchi estate. Sangiovese with international grapes. Also available by the glass.

🍷 STYLE: Medium to full-bodied | Bright red fruit & soft tannins | Modern Tuscan style | Approachable, versatile.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Grilled meats, pasta, pizza, Italian classics.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Perfect introduction to Super Tuscan style. Bridge between traditional and modern!

name: "Ardito" by Baracchi
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (baracchiwinery.com) Premium Super Tuscan from Baracchi estate. Rated 93 pts by James Suckling. Step-up from O'Lillo with more structure and complexity.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Super Tuscan | Rich dark fruit, spice & oak | Concentrated, complex | Modern winemaking | Excellent aging potential.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Bistecca Fiorentina, lamb, aged cheese, rich Italian dishes.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Serious wine for enthusiasts. Same producer as O'Lillo but more prestigious!

name: Tenuta San Guido "Le Difese"
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (tenutasanguido.com) From the legendary Sassicaia estate! 'Baby Sassicaia' Cabernet-Sangiovese blend. Rated 92 pts by Decanter.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Super Tuscan | Dark fruit & elegant structure | Classic Bolgheri terroir | Prestigious pedigree.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Grilled meats, pasta, game, Italian classics.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften tannins and open up complex layers.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Taste the famous Sassicaia terroir at an accessible price. Prestigious name, attainable bottle!

name: Gaja Ca'Marcanda "Magari"
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (gaja.com) From legendary Gaja's Tuscan estate Ca'Marcanda in Bolgheri. Bordeaux-style Cabernet blend. Approachable Gaja from Italy's most famous winemaker!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Bordeaux blend | Red fruit, spice & elegance | Classic Bolgheri style | Prestigious pedigree.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Roasted meats, game, aged cheese, special occasions.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften tannins and open up complex layers.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Taste Gaja's Tuscany at an accessible price. Collector-worthy producer!

name: Antinori Tignanello
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (antinori.it) Legendary Tignanello - the wine that INVENTED the Super Tuscan category in the 1970s! From 600-year-old Antinori family. Sangiovese-Cabernet blend.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied icon wine | Dark fruit, spice & oak | Complex, age-worthy | Revolutionary Tuscan winemaking | Benchmark Italian wine.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Bistecca Fiorentina, lamb, truffles, finest cuts.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften tannins and open up complex layers.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Must-try for serious collectors. The wine that changed Italian winemaking forever!

name: Sassicaia
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (tenutasanguido.com) LEGENDARY wine that started the Super Tuscan movement! Cabernet blend. Only Super Tuscan with its own DOC. One of Italy's greatest wines ever made!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied icon | Elegant, powerful & age-worthy | Extraordinary depth | World-class pedigree | Investment-grade wine.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Finest beef, game, truffles, once-in-lifetime celebrations.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften tannins and open up complex layers.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: For ultimate collectors. The wine that revolutionized Italian winemaking!

name: Antinori Solaia
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (antinori.it) Antinori's MASTERPIECE rated 98 pts by James Suckling! Cabernet-dominant blend with extraordinary complexity, power & elegance. From single vineyard next to Tignanello. One of the world's greatest wines!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied masterpiece | Extraordinary complexity & power | Age-worthy for decades | World-class pedigree | Ultimate Italian wine.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Finest cuisine, white truffle, once-in-lifetime celebrations.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften tannins and open up complex layers.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: For serious collectors only. Ultimate Italian wine experience!
